summary: The published standard deal is up to $1M, split into $500K for 10% upfront on a SAFE and up to another $500K in a later qualifying round of $2M+ within 18 months. The $10M+ partner credits are a separate benefit. They are not cash and not the SAFE. The 10% is not a claim about the whole package.
formattedTerms:
Our standard deal is up to $1M: $500K for 10% upfront on a SAFE, and up to an additional $500K in your next qualifying round ($2M+) within 18 months. Our current standard deal does not include a board seat. We ask for pro rata rights in future rounds and for an option pool for your early hires.

Through the speedrun Marketplace, you get access to $10M+ in credits from 200+ partners: cloud providers, model providers, and the software you use every day. For many companies, that goes a long way toward early costs. Credits unlock once your investment is wired. Amounts and terms are set by each partner and can change.

parts.condition: Next qualifying round of $2M+ within 18 months
